Block repair forest API with tree, frontier, insert, publish, iterate, and verify functions.

# Purpose
`fd_forest.h` defines the public interface for the `forest` data structure, which tracks discovered blocks and repairs missing shreds in a fork-aware tree. The file describes how the structure records slot ancestry, frontier leaves, orphaned subtrees, and consumed blocks, then uses that state to support block repair as shreds and votes arrive from Turbine or Gossip. It also defines the main block record `fd_forest_blk_t`, the top-level container `fd_forest_t`, and the supporting pool, map, list, deque, and set types used to store and link forest elements in shared memory.

The header provides the full lifecycle API for the structure: memory sizing, allocation, join and leave, initialization and finalization, verification, and deletion. It also declares the main operations for inserting blocks, data shreds, code shreds, and FEC sets, clearing completed FEC state, publishing a new root, and iterating over frontier nodes for repair work. Accessor functions expose the shared-memory substructures and root state, while print helpers support debugging and inspection.
